note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), entry 170; the original is in English. The original describes the alate and the soldier, with no worker description. The original gives the postclypeal width as “0.35-37”, the last digit being damaged by OCR, so that width is not recorded. The synonym list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records have been omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellowish brown, antennae brownish yellow, mandibles reddish brown, pronotum yellow, legs and abdomen yellowish white. Pilosity of the head moderate, denser at the frontal projection; the pronotum with fewer hairs than the head, the abdomen densely hairy. Head subrectangular, length to the mandibular base 0.84–0.98, maximum width 0.75–0.79 mm; the apex of the frontal projection broadly rounded; in lateral view the anterior margin slightly concave, the head surface behind the frontal projection without a depression. Frontal gland large. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2 and 3 subequal, segment 4 shortest. Anterior margin of the labrum deeply concave, the anterolateral angles acute, each side with 1 seta. Mandibles long and slender, rod-like, the apex hooked, longer than the head, left mandible 1.0–1.06 mm, slightly incurved in lateral view. Postmentum short, rod-like, strongly arched, length 0.33–0.38, maximum width 0.24–0.25 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin slightly concave, posterior margin convex, length 0.14–0.17, width 0.35–0.40 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, pale yellow around the fontanelle; antennae light brown; postclypeus and pronotum yellowish brown. Head and pronotum densely covered with short hairs and scattered long setae. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long, length to the labral apex 0.93–0.97, length to the mandibular base 0.57–0.60, maximum width including the eyes 0.78–0.81 mm. Fontanelle distinct. Eyes subcircular, maximum diameter 0.21–0.23 mm, the lower margin about 1/4 of its diameter from the lower margin of the head, that is, 0.05–0.06 mm. Ocelli oval, long diameter 0.09–0.10, short diameter 0.07 mm, their distance from the eye slightly less than their short diameter, that is, 0.05 mm. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus slightly raised, hairy, length 0.14–0.18 mm. Pronotum narrower than the head, the anterior and posterior margins slightly concave in the middle, the lateral margins rounded, length 0.43–0.45, width 0.65–0.71 mm.
